our_title: SCOTCH_meshOrderSave* index the label array by element positions, so orderings of labeled meshes carry wrong labels
ran: export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$INFRA/asan/lib (pristine) or $WORK/build/lib (patched); see repro/README. $WORK/build/bin/mord $WORK/scotch/src/check/data/small2_lbl.msh /dev/stdout (patched series, labels verbatim: elements 10..15, nodes 20..26) -> '7' then '10\t13' '11\t20' '12\t12' ...: the first column should list the node labels 20..26 and the second column node labels too; element labels are printed instead. Pristine prints the same kind of garbage ('0 3','1 2',... for m16_lbl.msh: labels of vertices 0..3 = two elements then two nodes).
evidence: library_mesh_order.c:147 `return (orderSave (&((LibOrder *) ordeptr)->o, ((Mesh *) CONTEXTOBJECT (meshptr))->vlbltax, stream));` while order_io.c:158-159 reads `vlbltax[vertnum + ordeptr->baseval]` and `vlbltax[permtab[vertnum]]` for node ordinals vertnum in [0, vnodnbr): with elements first those are element positions (mesh.h:98-104 states node ordering indices are based at baseval, not vnodbas).

fix_options.label: Shift the label array to the node range
fix_options.summary: Pass `vlbltax + (vnodbas - baseval)` (NULL stays NULL) in the three SCOTCH_meshOrderSave* routines.
fix_options.tested: syntax-checked only (file not in this group; not in the series)
fix_options.tradeoffs: Nodes-first meshes have vnodbas == baseval so the offset is 0 there; elements-first meshes get the right labels.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: One-line, same shape as the CONTEXTOBJECT edits he made in this file in 6a030db.

fix_options.label: Document that mesh ordering files use node ordinals, not labels
fix_options.summary: Pass NULL as label array for meshes.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Loses the label feature for meshes; simplest.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Less likely: the API advertises vertex labels in orderings.

our_title: meshLoad shifts vertex labels by the kind base while meshSave writes them raw: labeled mesh files are not stable and lose their labels
ran: export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$INFRA/asan/lib (pristine) or $WORK/build/lib (patched); see repro/README. $INFRA/asan/bin/mcv $WORK/repro/PS-SEP-1/m16_lbl.msh /dev/stdout -is -os (pristine; nodes labeled 0..3 in the file) -> node lines '2\t1\t0' '3\t2\t0\t1' ... i.e. labels 2..5 written (then the PS-SEP-1 crash); $WORK/build/bin/mcv (patched) on data/small2_lbl.msh -> output identical to the input (diff), mtst OK; test_scotch_mesh_geom with small2_lbl.xyz keyed by the file labels passes; pristine mcv on small2_lbl.msh differs from the input. Also with pristine semantics a labeled base-1 file cannot be loaded unless its edge ends are label+1 (dead agent's m16_lbl_b1.msh), and the first pass's m16.msh (labels overlapping across kinds) is now rejected: 'graphLoad2: duplicate vertex label'.
evidence: mesh_io.c:221 `meshptr->vlbltax[vertnum] = vlblval + vertbas + baseadj; /* Adjust vertex label */`; :266 `meshptr->edgetax[edgenum] = edgeval + edgeadj;` then graphLoad2 relabels; meshSave:383 writes `meshptr->vlbltax[vertnum]` and :392 `meshptr->vlbltax[meshptr->edgetax[edgenum]]` raw. s_f.tex:170-176 only says the first velmnbr lines are elements 'irrespective of their vertex labels'; graphLoad stores labels verbatim (graph_io.c:199).

fix_options.label: Store labels verbatim; edge ends of labeled meshes are labels (graphLoad semantics)
fix_options.summary: Drop the `+ vertbas + baseadj`; set edgeadjtab to 0 for labeled meshes; graphLoad2 enforces label uniqueness across both kinds. Add the mcv round trip of small2_lbl.msh and the labeled geometry test.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Behaviour change for base-0 labeled files whose element and node labels overlap: they now fail with 'duplicate vertex label' (they loaded before but produced shifted labels on every output). Design decision for the maintainer: this commit is last in the series so it can be dropped without conflicts.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Matches graphLoad/graphSave (his files) and the doc; keeps mcv idempotent, which check_prog_mcv already requires for unlabeled meshes.

fix_options.label: Keep the shifted in-memory labels and make meshSave undo the shift
fix_options.summary: Write vlbltax - vertbas for labels and label - otherbase + baseval for edge ends.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Round trip restored, but labels in orderings and geometry files stay shifted and overlapping labels across kinds stay ambiguous.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Preserves an undocumented encoding; he prefers one convention shared with graphs.
